reveal_policy: source facts and agent-authored descriptions visible; no agent verdict supplied
known_limitations: 浏览器草稿和主题预览只作用在此页；导出后手动导入设置
源码引用是构建时静态线索，不是 Runtime 状态或完整动态调用证明
history_retention_policy: append-only user edit events; original source snapshot preserved; reset is an explicit revert event
decision_question: Does this icon communicate this exact semantic role; what icon, function, meaning or note should change?
downstream_effect: Export proposes exact semantic-ID edits; agent acts only on later authorized implementation request.
information_architecture: Left categories; center visual gallery or semantic matrix; right one role's source evidence and editable proposal. Source details progressive disclosure.
workflow: Find icon → choose semantic role → change fields → local saved signal → copy/download canonical packet. Import can resume the same page.
control_surface_map: Header: import/copy/export. Center: search/category filter/modified filter/gallery-vs-matrix. Inspector: role selector, glyph picker, 3 text fields, per-role restore. Draft drawer: global restore with confirm. No duplicate view switch.
reference_intent: direct_execute; data_context = current SVG geometry and semantic catalog; host_context = existing AgentMux Graphite/Mint system typography and density. No generated image required.
visual_decomposition: Neutral warm light shell, dark graphite text, muted mint selection with check marker, narrow-radius controls, clear row baselines, generous central real SVG preview. No marketing cards or decorative charts.
frontend_architecture: 原静态HTML/CSS/JS + 项目共享catalog/native projection/theme runtime/schema；Vite构建，无独立图标映射owner。
capability_route: Reuse project's own glyph geometry. Native input/dialog/select and DOM; no new framework or dependencies.
mobile_interaction_plan: Single-pane inventory; categories via select; details as modal full-height sheet with labeled close. Minimum 40px controls; no horizontal page overflow; picker single overlay with searchable icon grid.
hardening: Visible browser-local save/error state; source-backed glyphs and agent-generated descriptions distinguished; failed copy uses export fallback; malformed imports validated before write; new source snapshot is surfaced without discarding drafts; histories exported; disabled storage keeps edits in memory and explicit export route.
public_capability_judgment: 复用原主题文件schema与Settings导入；任务内离线审阅页不新增JSON-RPC/CLI或保存owner。
